about: Plan 7.9 / W10.E12: what a real eval run must be for scripts/eval/ingest.mjs to take it, and when a model becomes an agent's default. A run against the fake server (kind "wiring") is never taken. An agent's default is the best model whose pass rate on that agent's cases is at least `threshold`, over at least `minCases` cases, with an open licence (class "allowed" in models/registry.json).
